report.headline: The estate's recorded prior (rules/common/fan-out-contract.md C2: 5 of 8 refutations were overclaims with the code fine) REPRODUCES here, but the overclaim MECHANISM is different from the one this unit was told to expect. Zero of 69 CONFIRMED claims are an arithmetic overclaim (a universal backed by a smaller sample) once the instrument is fixed. All 4 decisive refutations are the SAME shape: a present-tense absolute negative with no as-of qualifier, true when measured and false at HEAD. The single non-temporal finding is an unattested denominator (W2-01's '103/103' against evidence that only ever measures 97).

population_level_classification.note: probe-1 classes are ESCALATIONS, not verdicts. Only the 10 deep-hunted targets above carry a verdict; the other 59 rows are NOT-CHECKED by probe 2 (residual_unknowns RU-2).

what_would_change_this_verdict: If a 103/103 blueprint validator run exists elsewhere in the repo, T5 becomes CONFIRMED with a citation fix rather than a scope defect.
If T1/T3/T4 turn out to have been false at their OWN authoring commits, those three change class from decay to fabrication - a materially worse finding. Settling experiment in residual_unknowns RU-4.
If the markdown corpus (not audited) carries a materially different overclaim rate, the headline 'zero arithmetic overclaims' does not generalise past JSON records. Settling experiment in RU-1.

probe_1_rule_set_v2.SCOPED-OK: no universal quantifier; or a universal whose governed population is attested in the evidence text; or an exhaustive ratio A/A whose denominator A appears in the evidence
probe_1_rule_set_v2.ARITH-OVER: universal over population N while the evidence declares an explicit sample of X with X < N
probe_1_rule_set_v2.UNATTESTED-POP: universal governs a population numeral N that the evidence text never mentions
probe_1_rule_set_v2.UNBOUNDED-UNIV: universal with no population numeral governed by it - unfalsifiable by arithmetic, escalate to probe 2
probe_1_rule_set_v2.NEG-UNIVERSAL: absolute negative (never/cannot/none/no/zero/impossible/does not exist) - no finite positive sample can establish it, escalate to probe 2
probe_1_rule_set_v2.anchor_stripping: file:line, #PR, ISO dates, versions and unit ids are removed from the claim BEFORE numeral extraction; omitting this step is what broke v1

extensions.reproduction: The three probe scripts were run from %TEMP%/.../scratchpad (this unit is scoped to write only its own output_path). Every ruling above is independently re-runnable from the `probe_command` recorded on it, without the scripts.

self_audit.note: The instrument was turned on this unit's OWN claims and the result is reported rather than suppressed. 2 of 7 classify SCOPED-OK; the other 5 escalate (3 UNBOUNDED-UNIV, 2 NEG-UNIVERSAL). Probe-1 classes are ESCALATIONS, not verdicts - and this unit's escalations are the same shapes it flags elsewhere, so it is not exempt from its own finding. Mitigation actually applied: every one of the 7 claims states its population explicitly (69 audited rows, 7 of 7 v1 findings, 4 of 10 hunted targets, 3 detector failures) and every number is re-derivable from a recorded command. The strongest remaining caveat, per the spec anchor: these 7 claims describe a JSON-only corpus at HEAD 3a19b9a3 and have had NO cross-vendor review.
